facts.fact: The document presents itself as the reviewed Zimbabwe National ICT Policy 2022-2027 (ZNICTP 2022), with a presidential foreword and signature block, replacing the 2016-2020 policy that had elapsed; it states no adoption date, so 2022 is its published year.
facts.system: Zimbabwe National Information and Communication Technology Policy 2022-2027

facts.fact: The full text of the policy is a government document held in the corpus as a complete PDF text layer; no date is given, so 2022 is its published year.
facts.system: Zimbabwe National Information and Communication Technology Policy 2022-2027

facts.fact: The policy titles itself for the period 2022-2027 and its implementation-plan periods run to 2027.
facts.system: Zimbabwe National Information and Communication Technology Policy 2022-2027

facts.fact: Table 4 sets out an implementation plan of actions by priority area with responsible bodies and periods (2023 to 2027) but states no costs.
facts.system: Zimbabwe National Information and Communication Technology Policy 2022-2027

facts.fact: The policy names the Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services as coordinator, a National ICT Policy Advisory Council led by the Minister and a Policy Implementation Secretariat to track implementation, with POTRAZ as lead regulator.
facts.system: Zimbabwe National Information and Communication Technology Policy 2022-2027

facts.fact: The policy says the ministry will be provided with adequate resources and Parliament should advocate funding, but ties no budget line or amount to the policy.
facts.system: Zimbabwe National Information and Communication Technology Policy 2022-2027
